notes.text: The short atomic checkout includes token lookup. Own replay terminates with the existing order. Other denied requests terminate. Only an unused valid token continues; simulator choice already occurred.

continuation: confirmCheckout: Part A of A–E; previous none; next Part B; same request, no new human wait.
realisation_note: Simulator approve/decline choice precedes this request. Short atomic checkout begins before token lookup. Own existing token → existingOrder, no reprice, authorization or insertion (UC01-MG02). Foreign token → refusal. Unused token rechecks eligibility, raw radius, capacity, voucher and full consent. Actual guarded regions now enclose the messages they govern; exact native IDs and bounds are in interaction_fragments.
